text:
ana_marketing: Quick sync — we want to lock the announce for tomorrow 11:00 PT. Need final changelog link, docs URL, and benchmark blurb. Who's got the PR?

devin_eng: Changelog PR is open -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/changelog/pull/492 ; waiting on an approval from QA. Docs draft live in staging: https://docs.staging.redwood.ai/release/2026-03-23

lina_product: Can we confirm canary window? Product wants a 30m canary starting 10:40 PT, then full rollout at 11:10 PT if no regressions. Also need a single-sentence explainer for the banner (25 words).

sam_ops: Ops ok for the 10:40 canary, I scheduled the rollout job. release-bot posted the deploy job: `deploy job #778 scheduled for 2026-03-23T10:40:00-07:00`

release-bot: Deploy job #778: canary->global. Canary window 00:30. Targets: hosted-api, dedicated-gpu-pool A. Health checks: /health, token-latency.

ana_marketing: @devin can you paste the bench numbers we want in the blog? Need 1-2 key metrics (latency + cost delta) and a short sentence on methodology.

devin_eng: Bench numbers: median 8.3ms per token (p95 22ms) on sequence=256 vs previous model 12.1ms per token. Cost delta ~ -18% per 1k tokens on typical request mix. Method: 50k requests replayed from anonymized production traces across regions, quantized 4-bit runs.

maria_growth: For the webinar CTA we need a 1-line hook and registration link. Draft: "See this performance live — join our launch webinar (Mar 25)" -> https://events.redwood.ai/webinar-launch

lina_product: Docs link needs a short "what's new" section. Devin — can you add the quickstart snippet? Copy below is fine: ```bash
# quickstart
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"rwd-1-large","prompt":"Hello"}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"
```

devin_eng: Added quickstart to docs staging. PR for docs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2103 — includes the bench section and the quickstart snippet. QA signoff expected by 18:00 PT today.

ana_marketing: Perfect. Two remaining asks from marketing side: 1) final hero image (1200x628) in S3, 2) canonical changelog permalink to include in the release email.

sam_ops: Hero image location: s3://marketing-assets/launch/2026-03-23/hero_v3.png. Changelog permalink will be `https://changelog.redwood.ai/2026-03-23-rwd-runtime` after merge + deploy to the changelog site.

ana_marketing: Great — can someone drop a final confirmation here once QA merges and the changelog URL is live? I want to pin the email at 09:30 PT tomorrow.

devin_eng: QA approved and merged changelog PR at 17:42 PT. Changelog site staging shows entry. Awaiting the deploy to push the canonical URL to prod.

release-bot: Deploy #778 completed canary at 11:10 PT, no alerts. Full rollout initiated at 11:12 PT.

maria_growth: All assets pulled into the announce doc. Draft publish times: blog + email 11:00 PT, social thread at 11:05 PT, webinar CTA live after email.

ana_marketing: Awesome — locking schedule. Final checklist: changelog URL, docs prod link, hero image, bench blurb, webinar link, inbound lead webhook (maria pls verify). If all green I'll post the announce at 11:00 PT. :white_check_mark:

maria_growth: Inbound webhook confirmed: https://hooks.redwood.ai/inbound/launch leads -> CRM routing set. :thumbsup:

ana_marketing: Thanks all. If anything changes ping here immediately.

devin_eng: FYI we'll keep a short rollback window 0-20m after full rollout in case of regression, ops will alert on token-latency > 2x baseline.

sam_ops: Monitoring dashboard pinned: https://dash.redwood.ai/d/launch/2026-03-23

ana_marketing: Closing thread — see you at 09:30 PT for pre-flight and 11:00 PT for publish. :rocket:
